parameters.query:
WITH ctx AS (
  SELECT set_session_context($1::uuid, $2::uuid, $3) AS ok
),
proj AS (
  SELECT p.id, p.name, p.current_phase, p.location_city, p.tenant_id,
         p.property_type, p.property_area_m2,
         c.name AS client_name, c.email AS client_email
  FROM projects p JOIN clients c ON c.id = p.client_id, ctx
  WHERE p.id = $4::uuid LIMIT 1
),
plan AS (
  SELECT id, version, COALESCE(phases, '[]'::jsonb) AS phases
  FROM project_plans
  WHERE project_id = $4::uuid
  ORDER BY version DESC LIMIT 1
)
SELECT proj.*, plan.id AS plan_id, plan.version AS plan_version,
       COALESCE(plan.phases, '[]'::jsonb) AS planning_phases
FROM proj LEFT JOIN plan ON true;
